plugin.name: Magpie
plugin.description: Bring the magpie gateway running on this computer into Astravia: read its model catalog, publish it as an Astravia model provider, and use those models in chat.
view.label: Magpie gateway
view.description: Models served by the magpie gateway on this computer
status.offlineHint: Install and start it under Runtime below.
settings.title: Connection
settings.baseUrlHint: The default is fine unless magpie runs on another port.
settings.apiKeyHint: Only needed for a remote gateway.
models.title: Models on the gateway
models.empty: The gateway returned an empty catalog, so there is nothing to publish.
models.name: Model
models.truncated: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{total}} rows; narrow it with the filter.
runtime.title: Runtime
runtime.phase.checking: Looking for magpie on this computer…
runtime.phase.running: Gateway is running from this plugin
runtime.phase.failed: Install or start did not succeed
runtime.progress.hint: Progress refreshes every second; you can switch panels and come back.
runtime.progress.noTotal: This release does not publish a file size, so there is no percentage.
runtime.failed: The command did not succeed; its raw output is below.
runtime.unsupported: There is no official command-line build for this platform; use the installer from the site.
runtime.feedFailed: Could not read the release feed (usemagpie.ai). Check the network and retry.
runtime.installFailed: Install failed; the existing magpie was left untouched.
runtime.startFailed: Start failed; the gateway did not come up.
runtime.exited: The gateway process exited. Check the exit code and upstream log below.
runtime.note: The gateway is a child process of this plugin and stops when Astravia quits. To keep it alive: magpie daemon install.
runtime.manual: Or install it with the official installer
runtime.noShell: This machine has neither sh nor powershell, so the plugin cannot run any command.
runtime.noShellHint: On Windows this usually means PowerShell was removed by policy or PATH is broken; on macOS/Linux, /bin/sh is unavailable.
runtime.deniedHint: Allow sh or powershell under Settings → Plugins → Magpie → Commands.
note.title: What this plugin does not do
note.body: Keys stay in magpie's own config; publishing only writes the model catalog into Astravia.
error.unreachable: The gateway did not respond. Is magpie running?
error.notMagpie: Something answers at that address, but it is not the magpie gateway
error.emptyModels: The catalog was empty, so nothing was written
models.emptyHint: Add and enable a provider in magpie, then come back and check again.
models.partial: The gateway has more models than it returned in one page (has_more); these {{shown}} are not the whole catalog.
